arithmetic: Python standard-library Fraction sparse polynomials and rational elimination; no CAS or producer imports

smoothness.argument: The projective gradient zero locus is empty in the special fiber. Properness gives emptiness in characteristic zero. The six homogeneous gradients are a regular sequence in the six-variable polynomial ring.

complete_fixed_denominator_space.argument: Euler normalization turns every legal fixed-D certificate into N(F)=AD. The regular gradient sequence has all its degree-five syzygies spanned by the constant Koszul fields. The full nonzero E2 quotient has degree two. No field parity restriction is imposed.
complete_fixed_denominator_space.denominator_admissibility: A smooth sextic in P5 is geometrically irreducible; the nonzero quartic D is therefore relatively prime to F over C.

conclusion: Every legal homogeneous numerator with this particular quartic denominator is excluded, over C. The same holds for its nonzero scalar multiples.
limits: No exclusion of all quartic denominators, powers of this denominator, other supports, or certificates of arbitrary degree. No Lean proof or solution is produced.
